_about: Revision 1 of the bus-service-notices dataset (skku_content.datasets, _id bus-service-notices): each service's notices and suspension, in SERVICE_CONFIG's order, generated from the compiled SERVICE_CONFIG of src/bus/bus.constants.ts as production served it on 2026-10-19 at source commit 5c0ee5a9 (bus content unchanged since; move-editorial-datasets D7, task 11.2) with: npm run build && node -e "const {SERVICE_CONFIG}=require('./dist/src/bus/bus.constants'); console.log(JSON.stringify({services:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(SERVICE_CONFIG).map(([id,e])=>[id,{notices:e.notices,suspend:e.suspend}]))}))". The push imports this data with _about removed. Nothing trimmed.
